__title: MyWorkLog | Switch time tracking without losing data
__metaDescription: Move to MyWorkLog from Excel, paper or another time tracker: CSV and Excel import, photo of your paper report book, all in the browser. Step by step.
app.die_meisten_haben_schon_monate: Most people have already logged months — in a spreadsheet, in another app or on paper. That is exactly why a switch usually never happens. MyWorkLog reads the old data in, so you don't start from zero.
app.datei_aussuchen_oder_die_kopierten: Pick the file, or paste the copied rows.
app.spalten_pruefen_meistens_sind_sie: Check the columns — they are usually mapped correctly already.
app.in_der_vorschau_abhaken_was: Tick what should be imported in the preview.
app.fast_jede_app_kann_csv: Almost every app can export CSV — look for “Export”, “Download data” or “Backup” in its settings. Then use that file as described above. It does not matter what the columns are called there: you map them yourself in the second step.
app.aus_dem_digitalen_berichtsheft_der: From the IHK’s digital report book
app.das_berichtsheft_im_ihkserviceportal: The report book in the IHK service portal is being discontinued nationwide on 31 December 2026. Its PDF export (“Berichtsheftexport aller Einträge”) can be read straight into the report book: every week, every day, hours and sign-off status. Deadline, steps and what the import can do are on the page
app.die_kopfzeile_wird_automatisch_gedeu: The header row is interpreted automatically — German and English labels. If something is off, you change it with a dropdown. Only the date is required.
app.arbeit_urlaub_krank_berufsschule_fei: Work, holiday, sick, vocational school, public holiday, flexi-day
app.exceldatumszellen_und_uhrzeiten_als_: Excel date cells and times stored as a fraction of a day are read as they are — you don't have to reformat anything in the spreadsheet. Rows without a usable date are not silently dropped; they appear in the preview with a reason.
app.deine_alte_tabelle_kennt_in: Your old spreadsheet usually only knows the hours you worked. The daily target therefore comes from your settings in MyWorkLog — not from the file.
app.vor_dem_import_die_arbeitszeiten: Set your working hours before importing.
app.mehrere_eintraege_am_selben_tag: Several entries on the same day
app.nein_die_datei_wird_im: No. The file is read in the browser, and text recognition for photos also runs on your device. MyWorkLog stores your hours locally — there is no server they could sit on.
app.meine_tabelle_hat_keine_kopfzeile: My spreadsheet has no header row — does that still work?
app.ja_ohne_kopfzeile_werden_die: Yes. Without a header row the columns are recognised by their content: the column that mostly holds dates is the date, and so on. The first row is not lost in the process.
app.was_passiert_mit_tagen_die: What happens to days I have already logged?
app.solche_zeilen_werden_als_dublette: Such rows are flagged as duplicates and are unticked in the preview by default. Duplicate days distort the balance more quietly than a missing row — hence this direction. You can still tick them, for a genuine split shift for example.
app.ich_habe_mehrere_jobs_welchem: I have several jobs — which one does the import go to?
app.wenn_du_mehr_als_einen: If you have set up more than one job, you choose in the second step which one the rows belong to. Target hours and breaks then come from that job. For several jobs it is best to import separately.
app.muss_ich_alles_auf_einmal: Do I have to import everything at once?
app.nein_in_der_vorschau_hakst: No. You tick row by row in the preview. You can just as well read in one month first, look at the result and pull in the rest later.
soll.was_mit_sollstunden_und_saldo: What happens to target hours and balance

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The file is read in the browser, and text recognition for photos also runs on your device. MyWorkLog stores your hours locally.

mainEntity.name: My spreadsheet has no header row — does it still work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Without a header row the columns are recognised by their content: the column with mostly dates is the date. The first row is not lost.

mainEntity.name: What happens to days I have already recorded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Such rows are marked as duplicates and are deselected by default in the preview. You can still tick them.
Not the old .xls format. Save the file as .xlsx or CSV in Excel or LibreOffice, then the import works.

mainEntity.name: I have several jobs — which one does the import go to?

acceptedAnswer.text: With several jobs you choose in the second step which job the rows belong to. Target hours and break come from that job.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to import everything at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you tick rows one by one in the preview. You can also import one month first and add the rest later.

app.jede_zeile_mit_ist_soll: Every row with actual, target and difference, the balance change at the top. Days that already exist are deselected.
app.vier_wege_je_nachdem_wo: Four routes, depending on where your hours live today. All four run entirely in the browser — no file is uploaded, no account is needed.
app.vorschau_des_imports_in_myworklog: Import preview in MyWorkLog: every row with date, type, actual, target and difference, at the top 30 of 32 rows and the balance change
app.importassistent_schritt_1_datei_ausw: Import assistant, step 1: choose a file or paste rows from a spreadsheet, the field is filled with copied rows
app.importassistent_schritt_2_datum_von: Import assistant, step 2: date, from, to, break, type and note are mapped to the spreadsheet columns
app.importassistent_schritt_3_vorschau_m: Import assistant, step 3: preview with the balance change and all rows
